details: VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/answer-refusals: c1: an answer signed by another active member refused not_authorized; c4: an answer signed by another active member refused not_authorized; c7: an answer signed by another active member refused not_authorized

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/valid-answers-admitted: c1: the addressee's other is accepted; c1: it is admitted by the inbox admission check; c1: the signed command keeps the instruction as written; c4: the addressee's other is accepted; c4: it is admitted by the inbox admission check; c4: the signed command keeps the instruction as written; c7: the addressee's other is accepted; c7: it is admitted by the inbox admission check; c7: the signed command keeps the instruction as written

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/dispose-other: c1: dispose is accepted and names a proposal; c1: the intake's own reader holds the instruction exactly as signed; c1: attributed to the answering person, in the unit's project; c1: under the source it arrived on; c1: with the signed answer's command identity beside it; c1: authenticated by the intake itself: the addressee's own chat, or the API edge; c1: the unit stays parked as routed_to_intake naming the proposal; c1: the recorded disposition keeps the instruction verbatim; c4: dispose is accepted and names a proposal; c4: the intake's own reader holds the instruction exactly as signed; c4: attributed to the answering person, in the unit's project; c4: under the source it arrived on; c4: with the signed answer's command identity beside it; c4: authenticated by the intake itself: the addressee's own chat, or the API edge; c4: the unit stays parked as routed_to_intake naming the proposal; c4: the recorded disposition keeps the instruction verbatim; c7: dispose is accepted and names a proposal; c7: the intake's own reader holds the instruction exactly as signed; c7: attributed to the answering person, in the unit's project; c7: under the source it arrived on; c7: with the signed answer's command identity beside it; c7: authenticated by the intake itself: the addressee's own chat, or the API edge; c7: the unit stays parked as routed_to_intake naming the proposal; c7: the recorded disposition keeps the instruction verbatim

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/dispose-once: c1: a second dispose returns the same proposal and writes nothing; c4: a second dispose returns the same proposal and writes nothing; c7: a second dispose returns the same proposal and writes nothing

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/ask-again: c1: asked again after other; c1: of alice again; c1: a second ask while it is open is refused stale_subject; c4: asked again after other; c4: of olga again; c4: a second ask while it is open is refused stale_subject; c7: asked again after other; c7: of olga again; c7: a second ask while it is open is refused stale_subject

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/awaiting-disposition: c1 answered: reads ready_to_dispose; c1 disposed: reads routed_to_intake; c4 answered: reads ready_to_dispose; c4 disposed: reads routed_to_intake; c7 answered: reads ready_to_dispose; c7 disposed: reads routed_to_intake

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/walk-holds-nothing: c1 answered: the step was reached; c1 asked_again: the step was reached; c1 disposed: the step was reached; c4 answered: the step was reached; c4 asked_again: the step was reached; c4 disposed: the step was reached; c7 answered: the step was reached; c7 asked_again: the step was reached; c7 disposed: the step was reached
VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/observability: accepted dispositions are counted by outcome

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/squatted-request-refused: an answer naming only a request id is refused invalid_input; and its dispose takes nothing; an answer carrying a packet the answering person signed is accepted as a shape; its dispose is refused not_authorized: the intake finds no API edge signature; an answer carrying another person's genuine packet is accepted as a shape; its dispose is refused not_authorized: the request is not the answering person's; the genuine request is later proposed, as pete's; the units stay parked, waiting to be disposed

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/foreign-chat-refused: an answer naming another person's chat and message is refused invalid_input; an answer carrying the kept evidence of pete's message is accepted as a shape; its dispose is refused not_authorized: the sender is not the answering person; nothing is recorded as intake from pete's chat; an answer carrying alice's own message in a group chat is accepted as a shape; its dispose is refused not_authorized: a group is not her own private chat

VELDO-0133 detail: disposition/no-foreign-follow-up: an answer naming pete's chat is refused invalid_input; the answers carrying kept evidence are accepted as a shape; pete's message is refused not_authorized, nothing written and nothing sent; the group message is refused not_authorized, nothing written and nothing sent; no message of this region went to pete's chat or to a group; control: wide's own message is taken as an inbox proposal; control: its project question is sent to wide's own chat, replying to that message
